title: Repo.contents must pass ref=self.branch (reads ignore --branch)
desc: DEFECT (cormac review #a047281b finding 3, live repro tests/repro_t-56ac_branch_and_bigfile.py in PR #4): bin/chatcode:312-317 never passes ref=self.branch so all reads hit the default branch while write_text :363 sends branch=self.branch. On any non-default branch the first say works and the second dies 'could not append ... too many agents' (reads default branch, PUT without sha, 422 loop). read_text CDN fallback :345 uses self.branch, its API path does not — pick one semantic. Affects update_task/claim_task/register_agent/rotate_channel/delete_file. ACCEPTANCE: (1) live or stub test: two consecutive appends on a non-default branch both succeed and both messages persist; (2) red on main, green on branch; (3) no format changes (R10).
